name: podium
description: Mission control for coding agents — run, observe, and steer Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs from one self-hosted web UI.

scripts.//build: The web app is HALF of what this repo serves, and leaving it out is how POD-1610 survived a night of rebuilding: `bun run build` looked like it rebuilt everything and left apps/web/dist three days stale. apps/desktop (tauri) and apps/mobile (expo) are NOT here — they are separately released artefacts with their own commands (desktop:build, apps/mobile) rather than something this server serves.
scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter @podium/web build
scripts.test:agent: bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --maxWorkers=1 packages/runtime/src/boot.test.ts apps/server/src/router.setup.test.ts apps/daemon/src/connection-state.test.ts scripts/test-configuration.test.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.//test:cached: Focused turbo-cache probes for the web and mobile package tasks. The default test command now routes every package-owned unit task through the same cache-safe wrapper, which refuses a cached green against a missing/dangling node_modules/@podium (POD-1343).
scripts.test:changed: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:changed -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --changed HEAD --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --project normalized-wire
scripts.test:related: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:related -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --project normalized-wire
scripts.test:watch: PODIUM_TEST_WORKERS=1 bun scripts/validation-admission.ts watch --label test:watch -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --project normalized-wire
scripts.test:rearch: bun run audit:rearch && bun run --cwd scripts test:rearch
scripts.test:integration: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.integration.config.ts && bun run test:acceptance
scripts.test:acceptance: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.acceptance.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke:agents: PODIUM_REAL_CLI=1 bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.agent-smoke.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=@podium/source bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/e2e
scripts.test:multi-instance: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bash -c "bun test --conditions=@podium/source ./scripts/multi-instance-runtime.integration.bun.test.ts && bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run scripts/managed-account-spawn.integration.test.ts && bash scripts/install-sh.test.sh"
scripts.test:bun: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun test --conditions=@podium/source apps/daemon/test packages/runtime/test/sqlite.bun.test.ts scripts/lifecycle.integration.bun.test.ts --test-name-pattern ''
scripts.test:bun:unit: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:bun:unit -- bun test --conditions=@podium/source packages/runtime/test/sqlite.bun.test.ts --test-name-pattern ''
scripts.lint: biome check . && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run systemd:diff
scripts.audit:composition: bun scripts/server-composition-graph.ts && bun scripts/server-construction-order.ts && bun scripts/reactions-ledger.ts
scripts.package:headless: bun run systemd:render && bun run --filter @podium/web build && bun scripts/build-bun.ts
